patch_description: This crossover preserves the current implementation’s nonnegative demand handling and per-OD cap on indirect rewards, while borrowing the inspiration program’s endpoint-pressure signal for direct-link selection. A modest concave demand component keeps medium-demand links relevant, and transit-node weighting favors less-loaded intermediates. The capped two-hop terms avoid letting many alternative paths overwhelm direct-demand information; the degree penalty remains the evaluator’s responsibility.
